title: Cat rig sample (data half)
author: mewgenics-mods
description: The data half of the cat rig sample (framework API v5, DLL route). native/mods/catrig-sample (catrig_sample.dll) registers the rig clip RigSampleCatClip for the character entry RigSampleCat with FW_RegisterCatRig; this mod ships the entry (a TomTom variant, movieclip _CAT, custom_cat_data RigSampleParts), the control RigSampleVanillaCat on the same parts, and art/rig.scene.json, whose root clip is exported as RigSampleCatClip (NOT _CatRig_<Entry>, so only the DLL can bind it) with the labels idleF / idleB (a yellow marker over the cat) and hitF / hitB (the marker at 2x) only. Spawn-only test content (harness fights); no vanilla entry is changed. Build the SWF with the editor (npm run test:catrigsample builds it).
